description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for handling WhatsApp JIDs, self-chat mode detection, markdown conversion, and related operations within the openclaw plugin SDK, specifically tailored for WhatsApp integration.

methods.name: assertWebChannel
methods.description: Asserts that the input string is 'web', throws error otherwise.

methods.name: isSelfChatMode
methods.description: Determines if the current context is a self-chat mode based on E164 number and allowed sources.

methods.name: toWhatsappJid
methods.description: Converts a phone number string to a WhatsApp JID format.

methods.name: resolveLidMappingDirs
methods.description: Resolves directories for LID mapping based on provided options.

methods.name: readLidReverseMapping
methods.description: Reads reverse LID mapping JSON files to retrieve associated phone numbers.

methods.name: jidToE164
methods.description: Converts a WhatsApp JID to an E164 phone number, using LID mappings if necessary.

methods.name: resolveJidToE164
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves a JID to an E164 number, including LID lookup if needed.

methods.name: markdownToWhatsApp
methods.description: Converts markdown syntax in text to WhatsApp-compatible formatting, preserving code blocks and inline code.
